text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Qualifications of Electors (Exemption)
Order 2023.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 15 December 2021.

Exemption

2. The Yang di-Pertuan Agong exempts the following persons from the application of
Article 119 of the Federal Constitution and regulation 12 of the
Elections (Registration of Electors) Regulations 2002 [P.U. (A) 293/2002]:

(a) all Rulers and Yang di-Pertua-Yang di-Pertua Negeri, and their Consorts;

(b) the heir apparent, heir presumptive and other heirs of a Ruler, by whatever
style known, as specified in the First Schedule;

(c) consorts of the heir apparent, heir presumptive and other heirs of a Ruler
referred to in paragraph (b); and

(d) other persons as specified in the Second Schedule.
